page: Microsoft Azure D32pls_v6 is an ARM-based cloud server instance powered by 32 dedicated Microsoft Neoverse-N2 physical cores running at 3.4 GHz on the arm64 architecture. Hyperthreading is disabled, matching 32 physical cores to 32 vCPUs. The hardware configuration features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a low memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Cache hierarchy consists of 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 128 MB L3 cache. The instance contains no bundled local ephemeral storage and does not include GPU acceleration.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate high multi-core scalability and memory throughput. Multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench falls into the top 25%, supported by top-tier uncached memory bandwidth measuring 449.06 GB/sec for reads and 188.51 GB/sec for writes. The instance achieves strong throughput in single-threaded gzip compression, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, and static web serving at 50.4 GB/sec. Redis SET throughput reaches 61.87 million operations per second, and PassMark database operations register in the top 10%. Conversely, single-core CPU scores remain in the average tier, and large language model inference speed drops significantly on 70B parameter models.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio delivers high compute core density per unit of memory, establishing favorable cost efficiency for parallelized tasks that do not require high per-core RAM capacity. The lack of integrated local storage necessitates reliance on attached network storage for persistent disk I/O. Primary workload alignment includes scale-out web serving, software compilation pipelines, in-memory caching, and multi-threaded database operations.
description: Microsoft Azure D32pls_v6 is an ARM-based compute instance equipped with 32 dedicated Neoverse-N2 cores running at 3.4 GHz and 64.0 GB of memory. Operating on arm64 architecture with a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, this instance delivers top-tier uncached memory bandwidth alongside strong multi-core benchmark performance, including high throughput in static web serving, software compilation, and key-value cache operations. While single-core speeds and large language model inference capabilities remain average, the architecture excels in high-concurrency tasks with modest per-core memory demands. With no bundled local storage or GPUs, external persistent storage is required. The D32pls_v6 provides high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for scale-out web servers, CI/CD compilation pipelines, in-memory data stores, and multi-threaded database workloads.
